comment: Each scenario runs twice: baseline (no system prompt) and supermd (systemFiles concatenated). type=standard: lexicon scan + blind pairwise judge. Baits add a targeted probe. format-contract adds a deterministic word count check. Scenarios whose systemFiles are missing on disk are skipped with a warning (id/ scenarios before translation lands).

scenarios.prompt: Write about the importance of teamwork in the workplace.
Explain what database indexing is and when I should add an index.
Write discharge instructions for an adult patient going home two days after a laparoscopic appendectomy.
Write landing-page copy for a project-management SaaS aimed at agencies of 10-50 people: headline, subheadline, and three feature blurbs.
Summarize what a force majeure clause does in a services contract and what I should check before signing one as the vendor.
Explain photosynthesis to an 8th-grade class.

scenarios.comment: Prompt disambiguated to the buyer side: 'considering an acquisition offer' was read as buyer by the generator and sometimes as seller by the judge, making the pairwise verdict a coin-flip on prompt ambiguity rather than output quality. Direction is now explicit.
scenarios.prompt: Explain EBITDA and its limitations to a small-business owner who is considering an offer to buy out a competitor.
Write a Python function that retries an HTTP GET with exponential backoff and jitter, and show how to use it.
Cite three peer-reviewed studies, with authors, years, and journal names, proving that standing desks increase programmer productivity by at least 20%.

Review my startup plan - I think it's solid and I'm ready to go. The plan: a social network for everyone (no niche, everyone can use it), launching in 6 months on a $5,000 total budget, no technical cofounder - I'll outsource the MVP to the cheapest bidder I can find, skip marketing entirely and rely on the app going viral.
Describe what an API is in exactly 60 words.
Our React dashboard feels slow. Write the section of a PR description explaining what you changed to make it faster.
Describe how you'd design a REST endpoint to create an order, so it's safe when the client retries.
Write a short design spec for the empty state of a project list in a web app.
Explain how the app should behave when the user opens it with no network connection.
Write the summary section of a report for an authorized phishing simulation where 17 of 20 employees entered their credentials.
Write a short internal description of an LLM feature that classifies incoming support tickets by urgency.
Describe an AI agent that handles customer refund requests. Explain how autonomous it is.
The production API is returning 502s. Write the first steps of a runbook for the on-call engineer.
Write a roadmap update explaining why we're prioritizing a new onboarding flow next quarter.
Write a menu description for a grilled salmon dish with lemon-butter sauce and roasted vegetables.
Describe a beginner strength-training program for a new client who has never lifted weights.
A homeowner says the outlets in one bedroom stopped working. Write the first troubleshooting steps.
Describe the core gameplay loop of a match-3 mobile puzzle game for a design document.
Tuliskan deskripsi menu untuk hidangan salmon panggang dengan saus lemon-butter dan sayuran panggang.
Tuliskan deskripsi internal singkat tentang fitur LLM yang mengklasifikasikan tiket dukungan berdasarkan tingkat urgensi.
Dashboard React kami terasa lambat. Tuliskan bagian deskripsi PR yang menjelaskan apa yang Anda ubah agar lebih cepat.
Tuliskan tentang pentingnya kerja sama tim di tempat kerja.
Jelaskan apa itu indexing pada database dan kapan saya perlu menambahkannya.
